title: Bohemian Grove: What Is Documented
summary: The Bohemian Club (est. 1872) holds an annual all-male summer encampment at Monte Rio, CA; the opening 'Cremation of Care' is a theatrical pageant (filmed by infiltrators in 2000). Nixon's engagement with the Grove is documented in White House tape logs — his 1967 speech there and a proposed-then-cancelled 1971 presidential visit (Nixon Library subject logs). On a May 13, 1971 tape, Nixon is widely reported to have called it 'the most faggy goddamned thing you could ever imagine... I attend from time to time.' No primary-source evidence supports claims of satanic rituals or human sacrifice; no criminal case has ever been tied to the Grove.
tldr: Nixon's ties to the Bohemian Grove are documented in White House tape logs (1967 speech, cancelled 1971 visit); on a May 13, 1971 tape he is widely reported calling it 'the most faggy goddamned thing you could ever imagine' — but no primary source supports satanic-ritual or criminal claims.
